title: Soup on Saturday Night
setting: Grandma Rosa's warm kitchen with a high shelf of plates.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Grandma Rosa
characters.look: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick)

sentences.en: One rainy Saturday night in April, Ben visits Grandma.
sentences.zh: 四月一个下雨的星期六晚上，本去看望奶奶。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), in a raincoat, arrives at the door of Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) on a dark rainy night, and she opens it smiling.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben visiting Grandma on a rainy night; the day and month can't be shown.

sentences.en: Grandma Rosa makes hot soup from her home country.
sentences.zh: 罗莎奶奶做了一道她家乡的热汤。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) stirs a big pot of hot soup on the stove.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Grandma making hot soup; 'from her home country' can't be shown.

sentences.en: The plates are on a high shelf.
sentences.zh: 盘子放在高高的架子上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Plates stand on a high kitchen shelf above the head of Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick), who looks up at them.

sentences.en: Ben helps her get a few big plates.
sentences.zh: 本帮她拿下几个大盘子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) stands on a stool and takes a few big plates from the high shelf.

sentences.en: He hands her the brown plates with care.
sentences.zh: 他小心地把棕色的盘子递给她。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) carefully hands brown plates to Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick).

sentences.en: There is enough soup for everyone.
sentences.scene_prompt: A big pot full of soup next to two filled brown plates on the table.

sentences.en: Ben is excited and cannot stop smiling.
sentences.zh: 本很兴奋，一直笑个不停。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits at the table with a plate of soup, smiling widely, Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) beside him.
